description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Peru Peru 2026 national_statutory result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when choose calendar_scope and workweek explicitly. National holidays and public-sector compensable days have different applicability. This is a declared five-day (Saturday-Sunday rest) or six-day (Sunday rest) planning calendar, not proof of an individual's roster. Essential services, private-employer adoption, compensating shifts, regional holidays, banking, school, tax and procedural deadline calendars require separate evidence. The two compensable public-sector days remain working days for tax purposes. Later decrees require a new snapshot; dates beyond 2026 are unsupported.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events. Required calendar_scope and workweek distinguish national holidays from compensable public-sector days and five/six-day rosters.
Example user requests: Peru: National layer keeps July bridge open. | Peru: Public-sector July bridge. | Peru: Six-day Saturday.
Inputs: date (date); calendar_scope (enum); workweek (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-07-27","calendar_scope":"national_statutory","workweek":5} | {"date":"2026-07-27","calendar_scope":"public_sector","workweek":5} | {"date":"2026-09-19","calendar_scope":"national_statutory","workweek":6}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, calendar_selection, workweek, compensable_day_details.
Formula: working day = outside selected weekly rest and selected holiday layer
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/peru-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/peru-public-working-day.md

calendar_scope.description: Required: national_statutory uses 16 national holidays; public_sector also applies the two published compensable days. Neither is a tax or individual employee roster.

workweek.description: Required declared baseline: 5 = Saturday-Sunday rest, 6 = Sunday rest. Confirm the applicable roster.

name: check_pe_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

compensable_day_details.description: Public-sector bridge-day facts for the classified date, even when excluded from the selected layer.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Working under the explicit scope and five-day/six-day baseline.

substitute_day_policy.description: Published dates only; no automatic Monday substitution or employer compensation roster is inferred

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Peru Working Day
